title: Zesty Syrian Onion Kebabs
description: A salty and savory Syrian dish featuring crispy onion rings, perfect for midnight cravings. This kosher-friendly recipe uses dashi extract for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the onion rings with olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the onion rings out in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the onion rings in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
While the onion rings are baking, mix the dashi extract and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Once the onion rings are done, toss them with the dashi extract and lemon juice mixture until they are evenly coated.
Serve the Zesty Syrian Onion Kebabs hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
